facts.text: Geonosis, referred to as Geonosia by some natives, was the desert home planet of the Geonosians.

evidence.quote: Geonosis, referred to as Geonosia by some natives, was the desert home planet of the Geonosians.

facts.text: It hosted the Confederacy of Independent Systems major battle droid foundries and was the site of the First Battle of Geonosis, the opening conflict of the Clone Wars, as well as the subsequent invasion by the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: It hosted the Confederacy of Independent Systems major battle droid foundries and was the site of the First Battle of Geonosis, the opening conflict of the Clone Wars, as well as the subsequent invasion by the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Five years after the conflict's conclusion and transformation of the Galactic Republic, the Galactic Empire would garrison the planet heavily and attempt to mine the planet's asteroids for minerals.

evidence.quote: Five years after the conflict's conclusion and transformation of the Galactic Republic, the Galactic Empire would garrison the planet heavily and attempt to mine the planet's asteroids for minerals.

facts.text: At least five years after the Clone Wars, the Empire moved the Death Star to another construction site and the planet was sterilized by the Empire as a security measure, an act which resulted in the virtual elimination of the planet's native population.

evidence.quote: At least five years after the Clone Wars, the Empire moved the Death Star to another construction site and the planet was sterilized by the Empire as a security measure, an act which resulted in the virtual elimination of the planet's native population.

facts.text: It had a breathable atmosphere, but a hot and arid climate.

evidence.quote: It had a breathable atmosphere, but a hot and arid climate.

facts.text: Its irradiated surface was covered in harsh, rocky deserts, marked by mesas and buttes.

evidence.quote: Its irradiated surface was covered in harsh, rocky deserts, marked by mesas and buttes.

facts.text: Both its rocks and sky were tinted in shades of red.

evidence.quote: Both its rocks and sky were tinted in shades of red.

facts.text: Surface water was scarce, amounting to only 5% of the entire total planetary surface.

evidence.quote: Surface water was scarce, amounting to only 5% of the entire total planetary surface.

facts.text: The planet was orbited by fifteen moons, four of which were major and included the icy moon of Bahryn.

evidence.quote: The planet was orbited by fifteen moons, four of which were major and included the icy moon of Bahryn.

facts.text: At some point in the ancient history of Geonosis, a comet crashed in one of the planet's many moons.

evidence.quote: At some point in the ancient history of Geonosis, a comet crashed in one of the planet's many moons.

facts.text: The collision debris not only formed the famous rings of Geonosis, but also formed a field of small asteroids which would sometimes rain down on the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: The collision debris not only formed the famous rings of Geonosis, but also formed a field of small asteroids which would sometimes rain down on the planet's surface.

facts.text: When the Galactic Republic made first contact with the Geonosians, it was successful and beneficial to both groups.

evidence.quote: When the Galactic Republic made first contact with the Geonosians, it was successful and beneficial to both groups.

facts.text: Due to this, the Geonosians became interested with Republic technology and became skilled in adapting and improving advanced technology.

evidence.quote: Due to this, the Geonosians became interested with Republic technology and became skilled in adapting and improving advanced technology.

facts.text: Geonosians became split over the idea of working with offworlders, and with the planet's economy in ruins, wars erupted throughout the planet for millennia, while the rest of the galaxy largely forgot the planet and left it to its endless wars.

evidence.quote: Geonosians became split over the idea of working with offworlders, and with the planet's economy in ruins, wars erupted throughout the planet for millennia, while the rest of the galaxy largely forgot the planet and left it to its endless wars.

facts.text: A few hundred years prior to the Separatist Crisis, the world was rediscovered by the Galactic Republic and manufacturing deals were made to sell and distribute their advanced technology and droids.

evidence.quote: A few hundred years prior to the Separatist Crisis, the world was rediscovered by the Galactic Republic and manufacturing deals were made to sell and distribute their advanced technology and droids.
